mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of the Foreign Founding Shareholder Company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent registrar in the founding shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (convention in force for Viet Nam since 1 March 2024) OR Consular Legalization where the origin state is not a Hague Apostille Convention member

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Charter / Constitutional Documents and Board Resolution approving the investment in Viet Nam
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Board of Directors / General Meeting of Shareholders of the Foreign Founding Shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney appointing the Authorized Legal Representative of the LLC in Viet Nam
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Founding Shareholder / Foreign Legal Representative

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport / Citizen Identity Card Copies of the Legal Representative and all Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: National issuing authority of each individual's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization of the originating country followed by Vietnamese official translation and domestic notarization

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Charter Capital Contribution Schedule and proposed Member/Shareholder List of the LLC
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign Founding Shareholder (internal resolution) and subsequently lodged with the Department of Planning and Investment
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal corporate resolution certified; then submitted to the provincial DPI as part of the enterprise registration dossier

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced screening of all Ultimate Beneficial Owners, Legal Representatives, General Directors, and proposed managers against: (i) the United Nations Security Council Sanctions Lists; (ii) the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) and Non-SDN Consolidated Lists including the 50% owned-entity rule; (iii) the EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List; (iv) the FATF Public Statements and Jurisdiction Under Increased Monitoring list; (v) the State Bank of Viet Nam and Ministry of Public Security domestic watchlists; and (vi) adverse media / politically exposed persons (PEP) databases. Simplified Due Diligence may be invoked only where the customer risk assessment confirms the transaction qualifies as low risk under Articles 21-24 of Law No. 14/2022/QH15; however, for a foreign-invested entity with cross-border payment rails (PayPal Mass Payout, Wise), standard CDD is retained as the baseline and Enhanced Due Diligence is automatically triggered on any UBO identified as a PEP or any jurisdiction matching a high-risk third-country listing.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (NBRP) of Viet Nam — https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn, operated by the Business Registration Management Agency under the Ministry of Planning and Investment
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Articles 38 and 39 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Articles 21-25 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the enterprise name must be registered in Vietnamese script (Vietnamese alphabet, digits, and symbols), must contain at least two constitutional elements (Enterprise Type + Unique Proper Name), and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered enterprise. A foreign-invested LLC may additionally register an English or other foreign-language translated name; the foreign name must use standard Latin/romanized script and must appear on the certificate in parentheses or transliterated form. Transliteration must follow Vietnamese orthographic rules; local Vietnamese characters must be used for the official name while the English equivalent must be visibly distinct from comparable existing trademarks and registered company names.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam does not operate a standalone name-clearing certificate; the proposed enterprise name is assessed during the business registration dossier review. Under Article 26 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, an applicant whose name is rejected must first avail of the immediate correction procedure: the dossier may be amended and resubmitted without additional fee within the original submission window. If the DPI refuses to accept the amendment, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment within 30 days of the refusal, followed by a second-level appeal to the Minister of Planning and Investment or an administrative lawsuit before the competent Provincial People's Court under Law No. 93/2015/QH13. As a best practice, the applicant should simultaneously file two or three alternative names in the draft dossier to enable an instant switch upon rejection, and must ensure that the 30-day validity of the pre-screening name-search confirmation is not exceeded during the appeal period.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Prohibited as the sole registered head office for a foreign-invested LLC. Under Article 36 of Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 and Article 29 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP, the registered head office must be a physical, verifiable address in Viet Nam where the enterprise keeps its corporate seal, statutory records, accounting book, and where the management function is actually performed. A virtual office or pure mail-forwarding address is not admissible. A licensed co-working tenancy or a physical sublease with a dedicated management office and on-premise records capacity is permissible, provided the lease contract is notarized and registered in the enterprise application. The address must not be a state agency building, a hotel room, or an operational residence unless it has a separated commercial entrance and title evidence. For a market research SaaS platform, the head office must include the server/operations administrative facility and the local legal representative must be physically present during regulatory inspections.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 8% — Low-Moderate: the quantitative probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection by the Department of Planning and Investment, the Provincial Police (Economic Police), or the market regulator within the first 12 months is estimated at 8%, due to the low-risk profile of ISIC 7320 (consumer polling and market research SaaS). The likelihood increases materially to above 40% if the registered address coincides with a detected virtual mailbox, if a complaint of unpaid tax or corporate misconduct is filed by tenants, or if the entity is selected within a randomized annual compliance check cycle of newly incorporated foreign-invested enterprises.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) application dossier processing fee at the Provincial Department of Planning and Investment
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No statutory fee is prescribed in most provinces; where a provincial fee schedule exists, the charge is between VND 0 and 50,000 (approx. USD 0-2), governed by local Resolution on administrative fees.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Department of Planning and Investment — Business Registration Office
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Item 1, Article 47 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP: maximum fee of VND 100,000 (approx. USD 4-5) for the initial issuance of an Enterprise Registration Certificate.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization of Foreign Founding Shareholder corporate documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Viet Nam (Consular Department) or authorized provincial consular office; remunerated also to the foreign competent authority (e.g., Secretary of State) in the origin country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing consular legalization tariffs (Circular 297/2016/TT-BTC) set at approximately USD 25-35 per document in Viet Nam; plus origin country apostille fees of USD 10-20 per document; three to four documents required typically.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certified Vietnamese Translation and Notarization of the Founding Shareholder Dossier
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registered translation agency and licensed Notary Office in Viet Nam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate of USD 10-15 per page for certified translation plus notarization fee of VND 200,000-500,000 per document under Decree No. 29/2019/ND-CP.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and Sanctions Screening (KYB/UBO background check) on Founder and all Ultimate Beneficial Owners
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Third-party AML/CIP Data Provider (e.g., World-Check One, LexisNexis, or Refinitiv partner)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Per-record screening fee of USD 1-5 per individual per list set; total of 3-5 UBOs and legal representatives screened against UN, OFAC, EU, and FATF lists.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name Availability and Confusing Similarity Pre-Screening Search on the National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Ministry of Planning and Investment — National Business Registration Portal (NBRP)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: The online name-search utility is free of charge at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn; a certified written name-clearance statement, where requested by the majority shareholder, may cost VND 100,000-200,000 (approx. USD 5-8) under the provincial DPI fee schedule.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Office Package: Preliminary Lease Agreement, Notarization, and Lease Deposit Documentation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Landlord/Lessor and Notary Office in the province of registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for a modest office/co-working lease in Ho Chi Minh City or Hanoi: one-month security deposit equivalent of VND 5,000,000 (approx. USD 200) plus notarization fees under Decree No. 29/2019/ND-CP.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company Seal Production (Physical Rubber Seal and Optional E-Seal)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed seal-engraving enterprise in Viet Nam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: No state registration fee for seals since the entry into force of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP; market price for a standard corporate seal ranges from VND 300,000 to VND 600,000 (approx. USD 13-26).

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Corporate Secretarial Services and Incorporation Representation Fee — Local Law Firm
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Engaged Vietnamese law firm or licensed corporate agent
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market-established fixed fee for the establishment of a 100% foreign-owned LLC in Viet Nam, including drafting of IRC/ERC dossiers, legal translation review, UBO declarations, and coordination with DPI; typically USD 1,000-1,500 for a straightforward digital services entity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Charter Capital Opening Account and Adequacy Certificate (Bank Verification upon Contribution)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam (e.g., Vietcombank, BIDV, Techcombank, HSBC)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Most licensed banks open the charter capital contribution account without a monthly fee for the first statement period; after the first year an annual account maintenance fee of VND 500,000-2,000,000 (approx. USD 20-85) may apply as per the bank's published service tariff.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Publication of Enterprise Registration on the National Business Registration Portal
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Clause 4, Article 48 of Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP: publication fee of VND 200,000 (approx. USD 8) per enterprise registration.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Post-Incorporation Registration: Tax Code Activation, E-Invoice Registration, and Social Insurance Registration
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) and Social Insurance Agency of Viet Nam
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Tax registration and e-invoice activation are free through the GDT portal; an electronic invoicing service provider fee of USD 5-10 per annum is market standard; social insurance registration is free.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises of Viet Nam No. 59/2020/QH14, in particular Articles 24 through 31 on establishment and enterprise registration, Articles 46 through 56 on LLC charter capital, capital contribution, corporate governance and legal representation; supplemented by Law on Investment No. 61/2020/QH14, Articles 37, 38 and 40 on foreign investment registration; Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; and Decree No. 31/2021/ND-CP on investment registration procedures.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) for the province or central-city where the LLC is domiciled; filings are accepted through the National Business Registration Portal at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn. For projects located inside an industrial zone or economic zone, the Management Board of that zone is the competent registration authority.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Enterprise Registration (Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp), submitted together with the Company Charter, register of members, capital contribution schedule, Investment Registration Certificate, and documents evidencing lawful use of the registered office, in the forms prescribed under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Viet Nam imposes no general statutory minimum paid-up charter capital for an LLC engaged in ISIC 7320 market research and survey platform activities. The charter capital is determined freely by the member(s) in the Company Charter. However, the registered charter capital must be fully contributed within 90 days after the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued, or within the longer schedule expressly stated in the Investment Registration Certificate. Contributions by a foreign investor must be remitted into a direct investment capital account (DICA) at a bank licensed in Viet Nam. Failure to contribute on time requires an adjustment of the charter capital and member equity percentages through amended Charter and member list filings with the DPI.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
RESOLUTION OF THE SOLE MEMBER / MEMBERS MEETING OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY

Reference: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Enterprise Registration Certificate No. [ERC]; Investment Registration Certificate No. [IRC]
Date and place of adoption: [Date], at [Registered Office], Viet Nam

WHEREAS:
A. The member(s) have adopted the Company Charter and obtained all approvals required under Vietnamese law for a foreign-invested limited liability company.
B. The Company will operate a consumer polling and cross-border market research platform classified under ISIC 7320 and NAICS 541910, including SaaS subscription services and survey respondent compensation through permitted payment rails.

NOW, THE MEMBER(S) HEREBY RESOLVE(S) AS FOLLOWS:
1. Capital Subscription and Contributions: The charter capital of the Company is fixed at VND [X], divided into [Y] membership portions subscribed by the member(s) as set out in the register of members. The legal representative is authorised to open a direct investment capital account, execute the capital contribution schedule, and receive capital contribution certificates. Capital shall be fully paid no later than 90 days from the date of enterprise registration.
2. Registered Office and Corporate Records: The registered office of the Company is adopted at [Physical Address, including City/Province, Viet Nam]. The executed office lease and the corporate records are approved, and no business operations shall be conducted outside the registered address without an appropriate amendment.
3. Appointment of Officers: [Name] is appointed General Director and Chief Executive Officer; [Name] is appointed Legal Representative if that role is held by a person other than the General Director; and [Name] is appointed Chief Accountant. Each officer is vested with the duties and powers provided by the Company Charter and by Vietnamese law.
4. Seal and Signatory Authority: The Company seal, once lawfully created, is adopted as the corporate seal. The seal specimen and authorised signatories will be notified to the Business Registration Office. Signatures of any two of [Names] are required for transactions above VND [threshold]; one authorised signatory may bind the Company below that threshold, subject to applicable legal-representation rules.
5. Banking and Payment Rails: The General Director is authorised to open settlement accounts, the direct investment capital account, and to execute agreements with PayPal Mass Payout and Wise for lawful respondent compensation and cross-border settlement, subject to anti-money-laundering requirements and State Bank of Viet Nam regulations.
6. Effective Date: This Resolution takes effect upon adoption. Certified copies shall be sent to each member, each officer, and the registered office.

Adopted on [Date].

_________________________
[Name]
Chairperson / Authorised Member

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Obtain Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) and preliminary investment clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) or Management Board of Industrial/Economic Zones where the project is located; online via the National Business Registration Portal at dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn and the provincial public service portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The foreign investor must obtain an IRC before enterprise registration if the LLC is to be foreign-invested. Prepare a project proposal for a market research and digital polling platform under ISIC 7320, describing the SaaS business model, office location, capital plan, and proposed payment rails. Submit an electronic dossier with scanned notarised or certified documents. The registration authority appraises the project against the Law on Investment and, if the dossier is complete and compliant, issues the IRC within 15 working days. The IRC records the project name, business objectives, charter capital, and direct investment capital account requirements.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Registration (Form I-1 under Decree 31/2021/ND-CP)
Investment project proposal for the consumer panel survey platform and SaaS operations
Certified copy of the foreign investor passport or certificate of incorporation
Financial capacity statement, such as audited financial statements or a bank letter of confirmation
Lease commitment, memorandum of understanding, or other documents confirming the proposed registered office
Appointment documents for the legal representative and authorised representative list
National-security or sector-condition questionnaire if requested by the DPI
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI or Investment Management Board issues a request for supplementation, the investor must cure the deficiencies within 10 working days from the date of the written notice. If still incomplete, an additional cure period or resubmission is permitted. An adverse decision may be challenged through a complaint to the provincial People's Committee or through administrative judicial review under Law No. 93/2015/QH13 on Administrative Procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register the LLC and obtain the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment (DPI); online at the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within 30 working days after receiving the IRC, submit the company registration dossier through the National Business Registration Portal. The Application for Enterprise Registration, Company Charter, and member list must be in Vietnamese. The legal representative identity documents and office lease or right-to-use documents must be scanned and uploaded. The official ERC issuance fee is approximately USD 4 (VND 100,000). The DPI issues the ERC within 3 working days after receipt of a complete and valid dossier. The company acquires legal personality on the date of issuance of the ERC.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration in the prescribed Decree 01/2021/ND-CP form for an LLC
Valid copy of the Investment Registration Certificate
Company Charter approved by the member(s)
Register of LLC members and capital contribution schedule
Certified copies of passports or identity cards of members and the legal representative
Certified copy of the office lease or other document proving lawful use of the registered address
Appointment documents for the General Director and Legal Representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the DPI issues a deficiency notice, the applicant must correct and resubmit the specified items. If the deficiency notice is contested, the applicant may file a written explanation with supporting evidence. If the ERC is refused, the applicant may file a complaint with the DPI or the provincial People's Committee, or bring an administrative lawsuit under Law No. 93/2015/QH13.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Open direct investment capital account and pay in charter capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Bank of Viet Nam licensed commercial bank; applicable State Bank circulars on foreign direct investment capital accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the ERC is issued and before capital is remitted, the legal representative opens a direct investment capital account (DICA) in VND or a permitted foreign currency at the chosen Vietnamese bank. The bank performs customer due diligence and verifies the ERC, IRC, and Company Charter. The foreign investor then transfers the promised charter capital within 90 days from the ERC date. The bank records the remittance and issues a transaction statement or capital contribution confirmation. The statement must be retained for tax audits, capital verification, and future profit repatriation procedures.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Investment Registration Certificate
Company Charter and capital contribution schedule
Valid passport or ID of the legal representative and ultimate beneficial owner
Bank account opening application and KYC forms, including beneficial ownership declaration
Foreign exchange eligibility forms required by the bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account opening or remittance due to documentary deficiencies, the investor must correct and resubmit the bank forms. If the 90-day capital contribution deadline is missed, the equity portion of the non-contributing member is adjusted, and the LLC must file an amended Company Charter and register of members with the DPI within 30 days after the deadline. Non-compliance may result in administrative sanctions or rectification measures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Create company seal, notify seal specimen, and open operational settlement account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Department of Planning and Investment via the National Business Registration Portal; licensed commercial bank for the settlement account
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The LLC may decide the design and content of its seal. After the seal is physically created, the legal representative must submit a seal specimen notice to the Business Registration Office through the National Business Registration Portal so that the specimen is officially published in the national enterprise database. Simultaneously, the company opens a VND settlement account at a licensed bank for payroll, tax payments, vendor payments, and survey respondent payouts through lawful channels. The bank will require the ERC, seal specimen, and the board resolution authorising signatories.
required_dossiers: Seal specimen notice in the form prescribed under Decree 01/2021/ND-CP
Physical company seal
Enterprise Registration Certificate and Company Charter
Identity document of the legal representative
Board or members resolution authorising bank signatories
Bank onboarding and KYC forms
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the seal specimen notice is rejected because the corporate name, seal content, or specimen is inconsistent, the legal representative must make a corrected seal and resubmit the notice. Rejection does not invalidate the company; it merely requires administrative correction and resubmission through the portal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Activate tax registration, digital signature, and electronic invoicing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: General Department of Taxation and the provincial Tax Sub-Department; eTax portal at thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn; certified digital signature service providers
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The tax identification number is issued automatically with the ERC. The legal representative must complete the tax registration profile, register payroll and withholding tax obligations, and procure an approved digital signature for electronic tax declarations. Under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP, the company must register an e-invoice template or engage a certified electronic invoice service provider and issue electronic invoices for all SaaS subscription and market research fees. A standard value-added tax rate of 10% applies to domestic supplies; zero-rate VAT treatment may apply to export services consumed outside Viet Nam if the company holds the required supporting documents.
required_dossiers: Tax registration form (Form 01-DK-TCT)
Enterprise Registration Certificate and Company Charter
Confirmed seal specimen notice
Digital signature hardware token or remote signing service contract
Operational bank account details and signatory authorisation
E-invoice template registration or e-invoice service provider contract
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority rejects the filing or the e-invoice registration, the applicant must correct the information and resubmit through the eTax portal within the response window. If a zero-rated VAT claim is disputed, the company must provide the export service contracts, payment evidence, and PayPal or Wise settlement records demonstrating consumption outside Viet Nam.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Complete physical premises, fire safety, labor, and environmental registrations
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department (PC07); provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE); Department of Labour, Invalids and Social Affairs (DOLISA); provincial social insurance agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For the leased office used for the survey platform, the company must verify whether a fire safety acceptance certificate is required under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP and Circular 83/2021/TT-BCA. If required, the fire-safety design is submitted to PC07 and an on-site inspection is arranged. The company files a labour utilisation declaration with DOLISA, performs a workplace risk assessment, and registers employees with the social insurance agency. Because the business is a non-manufacturing digital service, no full environmental impact assessment is required; a simple environmental protection registration may be necessary only if the office wastewater discharge volume exceeds the small-source threshold under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP.
required_dossiers: Office lease contract and building ownership or occupancy certificate
Fire safety design dossier and fire safety acceptance certificate, if required
Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate
Labour utilisation declaration and employment contracts
Environmental protection registration form and wastewater discharge statement, if applicable
Social insurance registration forms and occupational risk assessment report
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If PC07, DONRE, or DOLISA issues a deficiency finding, the company must rectify the physical or documentary defects and request an expedited re-inspection. If a certificate is denied, the applicant may file a complaint with the issuing authority within the statutory period and may seek administrative judicial review.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a pure digital market-research and consumer-panel platform; no industrial manufacturing license is required. If the company later establishes a physical call center, server room, or data hall exceeding thresholds, the applicable authorities would be the provincial Department of Construction for building compliance, the Fire Prevention and Rescue Police Department for fire safety, and the Management Board of an industrial or economic zone if the operation relocates into such a zone.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: No sector-specific operating license is required under Viet Nam's Law on Enterprises and Law on Investment for ISIC 7320 market-research services; the Investment Registration Certificate and Enterprise Registration Certificate constitute the sole statutory operation permits.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (Bộ Tài nguyên và Môi trường) / provincial Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from full Environmental Impact Assessment because ISIC 7320 is a non-manufacturing digital service with negligible environmental footprint. The project does not fall within the project categories requiring an EIA report under Decree 08/2022/ND-CP. Only a low-tier environmental protection registration may be required for domestic wastewater from office premises if the discharge volume exceeds the small-source threshold.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Domestic wastewater from the office must comply with QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT for domestic wastewater before discharge. No VOC, particulate, or industrial effluent standards apply because no production process is carried out. Electronic waste and IT equipment must be transferred to licensed e-waste treatment facilities in accordance with the Law on Environmental Protection 2020 and Decree 08/2022/ND-CP. If the company later installs energy-intensive data hosting operations in Viet Nam, greenhouse-gas reporting obligations under Decree 06/2022/ND-CP may apply once the applicable energy-consumption thresholds are exceeded.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The leased office must obtain a Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate under Decree 136/2020/ND-CP and Circular 83/2021/TT-BCA if the premises meet the regulated thresholds for service or office buildings; for tenancies below those thresholds, the building owner’s fire-safety inspection certificate is sufficient. Structural load certificates are not separately required for leased office space; the landlord’s construction completion or building occupancy certificate evidences structural compliance. Under the Labour Code and Decree 145/2020/ND-CP, the company must file a labour utilisation declaration, complete a workplace risk assessment, register employees for social insurance, provide occupational safety training, and comply with all applicable workplace safety and hygiene standards.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) under the Ministry of Finance of Viet Nam, together with provincial Tax Departments and the Department of Planning and Investment in the unified investment-enterprise-tax registration procedure. National e-tax portal: https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn. National electronic invoice system portal: https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-invested Limited Liability Company (LLC), the statutory Tax Identification Number / VAT ID (Mã số thuế, MST) is granted automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC); no separate application to the tax office is required. Step 1 - Obtain an Investment Registration Certificate (IRC) from the provincial Department of Planning and Investment or the industrial-zone / export-processing-zone management authority where the project is located. Step 2 - Submit the enterprise registration dossier through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn); the ERC, together with the MST, is issued within 3 working days. Step 3 - Activate the company's electronic tax account at https://etaxvn.gdt.gov.vn using the legal representative's digital certificate, appoint the tax-authority bank account, and execute electronic tax filing and payment agreements; the MST is a 10-13 digit code with dependent-entity sub-codes where branches are registered. Step 4 - Register electronic invoice templates and issuance parameters with the tax authority within 30 days of MST issuance in accordance with Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC. Step 5 - Where a foreign company without a Vietnamese commercial presence supplies online SaaS / market-research services into Vietnam, the foreign supplier must register and obtain an MST through the dedicated foreign-supplier module of the e-tax portal under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC and may appoint institutions such as PayPal or Wise as payment intermediaries for tax remittance; however, where the local LLC is the taxable entity, it files monthly/quarterly VAT and CIT declarations on its own MST under the Law on Tax Administration 38/2019/QH13.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. The LLC is a Vietnamese tax resident subject to entity-level taxation: Corporate Income Tax (CIT) at 20% on worldwide net taxable income (territorial scope: global profits with foreign tax credit and treaty relief), VAT on domestic and imported consumption, and statutory payroll and contractor withholding obligations. Pass-through tax treatment is not available for LLCs; profits distributed to shareholders are non-deductible distributions. No tax-exempt zone status applies automatically; however, qualified new investment projects in high-tech zones, industrial zones, export processing zones, and eligible sectors may enjoy CIT holidays/reductions. The LLC remains fully subject to ordinary national tax administration and e-invoicing regardless of incentive status.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vietnam does not apply U.S.-style check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch elections. Available statutory choices include: (i) VAT method election: the credit/deduction method is mandatory where annual VAT-liable revenue is VND 1 billion or more; smaller or newly formed LLCs may use, in limited circumstances, the direct method on value added or direct method on revenue for the initial period; (ii) Foreign Contractor Tax / Foreign Supplier Tax election: a non-resident vendor without a permanent establishment in Vietnam may apply for treaty benefits and elect the applicable DTA withholding treatment under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC, or the offshore entity may be structured through a local LLC subject to domestic CIT/VAT; (iii) CIT incentive election: an LLC may elect, through the IRC process and tax filing, investment incentive regimes such as tax holidays or reduced rates for eligible high-tech, industrial-zone, or export-processing projects; and (iv) interest capitalization and related-party treatment elections under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, including the 30% EBITDA interest limitation and transfer-pricing safe harbours. There is no elective pass-through or hybrid-instrument regime under Vietnamese law; general anti-avoidance rules apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The State Bank of Vietnam (SBV / Ngan hang Nha nuoc Viet Nam) is the sole central banking, monetary and foreign-exchange control authority for the Socialist Republic of Vietnam. Its Foreign Exchange Administration Department (Vu Quan ly Ngoai hoi), Banking Activities Supervision Agency, and Anti-Money Laundering supervision divisions jointly administer the Law on the State Bank of Vietnam, the Law on Credit Institutions, the Ordinance on Foreign Exchange (Phap lenh Ngoai hoi, as amended by Ordinance 06/2013/UBTVQH13), Decree 70/2014/ND-CP, Decree 10/2022/ND-CP, Decree 101/2012/ND-CP (as amended), and the relevant SBV Circulars including 32/2013/TT-NHNN, 02/2021/TT-NHNN, 05/2014/TT-NHNN, 03/2015/TT-NHNN, 15/2015/TT-NHNN, 21/2018/TT-NHNN, 23/2019/TT-NHNN and 05/2022/TT-NHNN. The Ministry of Planning and Investment (provincial DPI authorities issuing the Investment Registration Certificate) and the Ministry of Finance (tax finalization confirmation supporting profit remittance) execute complementary roles in the foreign-exchange control architecture.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vietnam operates a managed-float foreign-exchange regime with regulated current-account convertibility and restricted capital-account convertibility. The VND is not freely convertible beyond the national jurisdiction; every foreign-currency purchase, transfer, or conversion must trace to an underlying lawful commercial transaction and must be executed through an SBV-authorized credit institution. Resident legal entities may not hold accounts abroad without prior SBV approval. For the VN LLC, current-account service receipts from the cross-border consumer panel survey platform are convertible: the USD revenue collected from foreign clients may be either retained in a USD current account at a licensed bank or sold to an authorized bank for VND at the prevailing interbank central-bank rate for working capital, payroll, NAPAS/IBPS mass payouts and tax settlement. Capital-account items remain heavily controlled: inbound equity must be paid into the Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) under the FDI currency-control framework, while medium and long-term foreign loans require pre-registration with the SBV under Circular 03/2015/TT-NHNN, as amended. Profit-remittance hurdles under SBV FDI regulations (Circular 05/2014/TT-NHNN): a foreign-invested LLC may remit after-tax profits abroad only once per fiscal-year cycle and only after (i) annual audited financial statements are issued by an eligible audit firm; (ii) corporate income tax (CIT), foreign contractor tax, VAT and all other taxes are fully declared, withheld and settled; (iii) the Members' Council adopts a formal profit-distribution resolution; and (iv) the enterprise submits a complete profit-remittance dossier to its designated authorized bank including the distribution resolution, audited financial statements, tax-finalization confirmation, and corporate banking attestations. The bank reviews the dossier and executes the wire once satisfied; the remittable amount cannot exceed cumulative retained after-tax profit less statutory reserve appropriations (5% annual reserve up to 10% of charter capital) and any accumulated loss offsets. Practical hurdles include the single annual remittance cadence, the tax authority's non-owing certificate requirement, strict separation of capital injections from service revenue in cash-flow documentation, and the bank's risk-based discretion to request additional underlying contracts, UBO declarations, and foreign tax-residence certificates.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: The VN LLC must repatriate all foreign-currency service-export proceeds into its foreign-currency current account at an SBV-licensed credit institution within 180 days from the contractual or actual completion of the cross-border service, in accordance with Circular 02/2021/TT-NHNN amending Circular 32/2013/TT-NHNN on foreign-exchange controls over import and export payment terms. Each receivable must be evidenced by executed statements of work, delivery acceptance certificates, and final invoices carrying a service purpose description. There is currently no fixed mandatory surrender ratio for general export-service receipts: the SBV abolished the standing percentage-based surrender obligation for resident economic organizations, and the enterprise may lawfully retain up to 100% of its export-service revenue in its USD balance at an authorized credit institution. However, all export proceeds must be transferred back into Vietnam; offshore accumulation is prohibited absent specific SBV approval, and when the enterprise elects to expend in VND it must sell the foreign currency to an authorized bank at the prevailing interbank or central-bank rate. The SBV has reserved the legal power to impose emergency conversion requirements or intervene through authorized banks during periods of acute FX pressure, and banks retain prudential discretion in purchasing foreign currency within their limits. For monitoring purposes, the receiving authorized bank reports each incoming cross-border transaction to the SBV through the national international-transaction reporting framework (ITRS-type transmission), identifying the purpose code, counterparty, and contract reference; the enterprise must align these inflows with its CIT, VAT and foreign contractor tax declarations.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Direct Investment Capital Account (DICA) and interdependent USD/VND operating current accounts

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Investment and Development of Vietnam (BIDV)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and operational VND/USD current accounts with dedicated FDI desk support

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Joint Stock Commercial Bank for Industry and Trade (VietinBank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational current account (VND/USD) and SWIFT MT103 outgoing settlement account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Vietnam Technological and Commercial Joint Stock Bank (Techcombank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Corporate multi-currency operating account with API-enabled treasury, FX hedging line and mass-payout interface

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Military Commercial Joint Stock Bank (MB Bank)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational account integrated with NAPAS/IBPS domestic disbursement rails and USD conversion account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW as a primary or principal banking rail for the VN LLC; MEDIUM-HIGH as a supplementary cross-border payout and collection facilitator. Legal constraints: offshore digital EMIs such as Wise, Airwallex and Payoneer are not licensed credit institutions or licensed intermediary payment services in Vietnam. They may not open or maintain local VND accounts for Vietnamese residents, may not originate domestic wire or NAPAS/IBPS transfers inside Vietnam, and may not act as a domestic payment processor unless separately licensed under Decree 101/2012/ND-CP and Circular 23/2019/TT-NHNN. The LLC may lawfully use such platforms for external mass payout distribution and small-value multi-currency settlement only where (i) the platform balance is funded by regular SWIFT MT103 transfers from the LLC's USD account at an authorized Vietnamese bank; (ii) the platform does not hold or intermediate the funds as a VND-denominated local deposit; and (iii) all platform balances are periodically swept back into the authorized bank so that the offshore accumulation does not become a treasury parking point. Every addition to a Wise, PayPal or Payoneer balance must be traceable to an export-service invoice and declared in the annual foreign-exchange reporting file; any attempt to use such platforms as the primary collection account for inbound client revenue would raise SBV cross-border settlement, AML and tax reporting concerns.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for the first corporate onboarding of a foreign-invested LLC: at least one legal representative with a valid passport (minimum six months validity) and a current Vietnamese entry visa or temporary residence card must appear in person at the selected branch for the face-to-face KYC interview. Remote or fully eKYC-based onboarding is not available, as a matter of current supervisory practice, for an entity with high-volume cross-border receipts and mass payout flows; eKYC is reserved for low-risk domestic individuals. In addition to the passport and visa, the bank requires originally notarized or certified true copies of the Investment Registration Certificate (IRC), the Enterprise Registration Certificate (ERC), the company charter, the Members' Council Resolution appointing the legal representative and authorized signatories, certified Vietnamese translations of all foreign corporate documentation, an anti-money-laundering UBO declaration with a source-of-funds explanation, proof of the registered head-office address (lease or ownership evidence), the tax registration certificate, and a written activity narrative confirming that the market-research survey platform does not require a separate sectoral license but will maintain documented respondent contracts, payout ledgers and client agreements for bank and regulator review.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly incorporated FDI LLC, operational for less than 12 months, presenting high-velocity cross-border receipts from foreign entities and one-to-many micro-disbursements to thousands of individual respondents - a pattern that may resemble an unlicensed payment intermediary, money-services business, or a pass-through treasury.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A bank-ready commercial and compliance bundle comprising: (1) notarized IRC and ERC showing ISIC 7320 market-research and public-opinion-polling scope; (2) executed master service agreements with at least three named international institutional clients, each with detailed scope of work, pricing schedules, service milestones, deliverable descriptions and signed acceptance certificates; (3) a respondent-panel compliance pack (informed consent forms, data-protection policy and DPO appointment, per-payee payout caps, sample payout ledger, fraud-control procedures); (4) an independent legal opinion prepared by a Vietnamese law firm confirming that the LLC is not engaged in e-money issuance, payment initiation, settlement, clearance or third-party payment aggregation requiring licensing under Decree 101/2012/ND-CP or Circular 23/2019/TT-NHNN; (5) interim management accounts, client invoices, and projected transaction volumes demonstrating the economic substance of the survey business.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity: foreign shareholders incorporated in jurisdictions with enhanced AML scrutiny, or a structure with nominees and layered holding companies, creating ambiguity about ultimate natural-person controllers.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A complete UBO chain report with passport copies of all ultimate natural-person controllers, the corporate incorporation certificates of each intermediate holding vehicle, notarized share-transfer and custody documentation, Apostille or consular legalization for foreign corporate documents, a written explanation of the source of the invested funds, DICA bank statements evidencing the equity paid-in trail, and a board resolution confirming the accuracy of the ownership declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transaction description mismatch: inbound wires referencing only generic terms such as 'consulting', 'research', 'marketing services' or 'digital services', which banks flag as trade-based money-laundering 'ghost invoicing' risk, especially where matching of invoice to service delivery is weak.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A contract-continuity documentary set: itemized commercial invoices referencing unique invoice numbers, service IDs, unit rates, quantities and the governing statement of work; time-stamped digital deliverables and data extraction logs; proof that the LLC is an active CIT and VAT taxpayer with registered invoices; certified Vietnamese translations of foreign-language invoices; and written confirmation letters from the foreign clients about acceptance and intended use of the survey data.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Business License Tax (Lệ phí môn bài)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department / General Department of Taxation via Vietnam e-tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable by 30 January of each year; first year of establishment is exempt; amount is VND 2,000,000 if charter capital is equal to or below VND 10 billion, otherwise VND 3,000,000.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or underpayment triggers administrative penalties under Decree 125/2020/NĐ-CP plus late-payment interest of 0.03% per day on the unpaid license fee; prolonged non-payment may lead to enforced collection, bank-account distraint, and temporary exit ban on the legal representative.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Report (Báo cáo tình hình hoạt động doanh nghiệp)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Business Registration Office under the Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) of the province of registration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the fiscal year-end; for a calendar-year entity, by 31 March of the following year.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Delay not exceeding 30 days: formal warning; delay beyond 30 days or non-submission: administrative fine of VND 10,000,000–15,000,000 under Decree 122/2021/NĐ-CP; failure to submit for two consecutive years may result in administrative strike-off from the National Business Registration Information System.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Audited Annual Financial Statements (VAS statutory financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) and Provincial Tax Department, as part of the annual enterprise report and CIT finalization dossier
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after fiscal year-end (by 31 March for calendar-year filers); the independent audit must be completed before the annual report and tax finalization are submitted.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Unaudited financial statements are treated as an incomplete filing: DPI may impose the annual-report penalty up to VND 15,000,000; tax finalization is considered late and subject to late-filing penalties up to VND 25,000,000 plus 0.03% daily interest on any underpaid tax; continuing non-compliance may trigger registration revocation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax (CIT) Finalization Return (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department via the national e-tax portal (General Department of Taxation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the 90th day after the fiscal year-end (31 March for calendar-year filers); if the deadline falls on a public holiday, the due date shifts to the next working day.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing penalty tiers from VND 2,000,000 to VND 25,000,000 under Decree 125/2020/NĐ-CP; underpaid CIT attracts 0.03% daily late-payment interest and possible misstatement/evasion penalties of 10–20% of the understated amount; enforcement may include suspension of invoices, bank-account seizure, and exit bans.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Personal Income Tax (PIT) Finalization Return for Employees and Contractors (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNCN)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Provincial Tax Department via the e-tax portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the calendar year-end (31 March); no administrative extension is available except in force-majeure circumstances under the Tax Administration Law.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing or under-withholding penalties under Decree 125/2020/NĐ-CP up to VND 25,000,000, plus 0.03% daily interest on any additional PIT due; the legal representative may face exit restrictions for outstanding tax debts.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: All foreign-invested LLCs, including 100% foreign-owned LLCs operating a consumer-panel survey platform, are subject to a mandatory independent annual audit under Decree 17/2016/NĐ-CP and the Law on Independent Audit 2011; there is no small-company revenue or asset exemption for FDI entities. Regulated sectors such as banking, insurance, securities, and state-controlled enterprises are separately and independently subject to audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Standalone statutory financial statements must be prepared under Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) and Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; IFRS may be used only for parent-group consolidation and supplementary reporting and does not substitute for the statutory VAS filing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vietnam does not maintain a standalone annual UBO confirmation filing regime. The LLC must, under the Anti-Money Laundering Law, keep current beneficial-owner records and must update the Register of Members upon any ownership transfer. Any transfer of membership interest must be notified to the DPI within 10 days, and the annual enterprise report serves as the annual declaration of the member list and paid-in capital; no separate UBO certificate is filed.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (with contributions and transfers)
Register of Directors and legal representatives
Minute book of the Members' Council meetings and resolutions
Register of paid-in charter capital contributions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard effective rate is 20%. Preferential incentives: eligible new investment projects in high-technology zones, software production, and high-tech enterprises are entitled to a 10% CIT rate for 15 years, a 4-year CIT exemption, and a 50% reduction for the following 9 years (Law on CIT No. 14/2008/QH12, last amended by Law No. 71/2014/QH13; Decree 218/2013/ND-CP). A consumer-panel SaaS platform does not automatically qualify as software production; without an official incentive certificate or registration as an eligible software-producing enterprise, the standard 20% rate applies to market research and data platform revenues. No other blanket exemption applies to ISIC 7320 services.
